svg.text: StoryBuddy IPO model: input, process, output
As of 2026-11-21. Process steps are the LangGraph nodes in backend/pipeline/graph.py (14 nodes).
one per main character, at most 2
reveal: the child keeps, redraws, picks another
version or uses the magic pencil
page safety check, then the book
A flag waits for the teacher to allow, replace or
stop. In baseline mode a flag fails the job.
notes for students on or off
each page: a picture and its text
Inputs: backend/app/main.py (CreateStorybookRequest: text, title, style_preset_id); backend/app/config.py (MIN_STORY_WORDS, MAX_STORY_WORDS, MAX_TITLE_CHARS, MIN_SCENES, MAX_SCENES,
Process: backend/pipeline/graph.py, reveal.py, moderation_review.py, compose.py. Output: backend/app/review.py (approve, reject), review_notes.py, pdf_export.py (approved books, student viewers).
Docs: docs/capstone/group-guide.md section 3; docs/specs/USER_FLOW.md; docs/specs/magic-pencil.md; docs/specs/export-pdf.md; docs/specs/research-page-refresh/evidence/audit-4-diagrams.md (b).
